test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the cost of a tadpole required to make a conical tent with slant height 15 m and height 9 m, when one square meter tadpole costs ₹147?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **radius (r)** using the Pythagorean triplet (9, 12, 15). Here, 15² − 9² = 12², so **r = 12 m**.

**Total Cost** = (22/7) × Radius × Slant Height × Rate per m²

⇒ Cost = (22/7) × 12 × 15 × 147 = 22 × 180 × 21

⇒ Cost = 3960 × 21 = ₹83,160.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹83,160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Slant height (l)** of the conical tent = 15 m

**Height (h)** of the conical tent = 9 m

**Cost of tadpole** per square meter = ₹147

**Formula Used:**

1. Radius (r) = √(l² − h²)

2. **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of a cone = πrl

3. **Total Cost** = CSA × Rate per unit area

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b397d6ee28cca593fdae9e69cdacb9298e34df582245af7f915c8b751689e37.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ r = √(15² − 9²)

⇒ r = √(225 − 81) = √144 = 12 m

⇒ Area of tadpole required = **Curved Surface Area** of the cone

⇒ CSA = (22/7) × 12 × 15

⇒ CSA = 3960 / 7 m²

⇒ **Total Cost** = (3960 / 7) × 147

⇒ Total Cost = 3960 × 21

⇒ Total Cost = ₹83,160

**∴ The correct answer is ₹83,160.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Slant Height Relationship

For a right circular cone, the slant height l, vertical height h, and base radius r are related by the Pythagorean theorem: l² = r² + h².

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cone

The TSA includes both the curved area and the circular base: TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).

Volume of a Cone

The space occupied by a cone is given by Volume = (1/3) × πr²h.

Material for Tent

When calculating fabric for a tent, only the **Curved Surface Area** is considered unless the question explicitly mentions a floor made of the same material.
